<!-- `.vet` runs `go vet` instead of `go run`: the package need not be `main`, findings exit non-zero (so `.expect-failure`), the `# <module>` header is dropped, `filename=` names the file, `.show-cli` adds the command line, and line numbers are mapped past the `<noshow>` lines. Findings of several analyzers come in random order from `go vet`; the filter sorts them by position. -->

```{.go .run .vet .output .expect-failure .show-cli module="example.com/vetdemo" filename="counter.go"}
package vetdemo

// <noshow>
import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"sync"
	"time"
)
// </noshow>

type Counter struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	n  int
}

func (c Counter) Inc() {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.n++
}

func Report(name string, c *Counter) {
	fmt.Printf("%s: %s\n", name, c.n)
	log.Println("am", time.Now().Format("2006-02-01"))
}

func Reset(c *Counter) {
	return
	c.n = 0
}
```
